Messages.Author: berni...@attbi.comholdlespam
Messages.Body:
FYI,

I've registered a couple of events to be ran at GenCon 2003 this summer.
Never recieved a reply back from WW as to what day they plan on holding
the Nationals this year, so assumed that it will fall on Sunday as per
last years event.

Here are the details as submitted to my sponsor, GameBase-7

In a nutshell;
Friday: Modified Constructed Format. Intention is to run it using
storyline format, with a possible mockup of a powerbase card for
Indianapolis. Obviously wouldn't be an official card, but would be a
great way to kick off the move to Milwaukee to Indy!

Saturday: Team Sealed. Same event as last year with a few changes to be
implimented for better balance. As per last year, only 12 player slots
for this event. If I receive enough interest, can expand it to 24
players running as two seperate events of 12 players.

Bernie Bresnahan
*Note: The event details are not yet posted on my website, as it will be
re-launching shortly with a slightly different layout/look.

===============================================================
GENCON 2003 EVENT SUBMISSION

FRIDAY
Name: Powerbase: Indianapolis
Event: Vampire:TES CCG
Format: Constructed w/ restrictions
Number of Players: Any
Time: 10am-7pm
Cost: $3.00
Judge: Bernie Bresnahan

Description: This event requires players to bring a constructed Vampire
CCG deck. The details for the event and additional rules for deck
contruction will be available at the website;
http://njl.vekn.org

SATURDAY
Name: Lunatic Eruption 2003
Event: Vampire:TES CCG
Format: Sealed Team Event
Number of Players: 12
Time: 10am-7pm
Cost: $23
Judge: Bernie Bresnahan

Description: Our annual Team event makes another appearance
at GenCon. Who is mightier? The Camarilla? The Sabbat?
Or perhaps the Independent clans?.
Cards will be provided in this special Team Sealed format.
Please check our website for further info as it becomes available.
http://njl.vekn.org

BernieTime
Lansing, Michigan
